messages:
elaine: Quick FYI — I landed a refactor PR that renames the core networking module and pins providers for reproducible plans. Need a quick smoke and lockfile regen check before we cut the canary tomorrow.

devops-bot: CI started for PR #4928 — terraform fmt/validate running. Will post plan once ready.

sam: pinged. which commands should I run locally? terraform init + plan? any special flags for the pinning?

elaine: yes run: `terraform init -input=false` then `terraform plan -var-file=env/staging.tfvars`. If you hit provider mismatch error try `terraform init -upgrade` first. Also look for provider constraints in `modules/core/providers.tf` — I pinned to `~> 4.15` for google and `~> 3.20` for aws.

mike: saw the PR. heads-up: the provider pin caused a plan diff on the k8s module because of `kubernetes` provider behavior change. Might be benign but check `kubernetes_manifest` ordering.

tara: also note I changed the k8s secret path mapping on the app manifests (annotation key moved from `redwood.com/secret-path` -> `rwd/infer-secret-path`). That will affect the secret-wiring script in binaries.

sam: running now... `terraform init` -> complains: "Failed to install provider \"registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/kubernetes\" v2.11.0: registry mirror policy".

mike: ah that's the mirror config we added in staging CI. Locally you can add `TF_REGISTRY_CLIENT_HTTP_TIMEOUT` or just mirror off. But for plan check you can set `TF_REGISTRY_MIRROR=''` to bypass.

elaine: updated the PR description with a snippet for the provider block, paste here for visibility:

```
terraform {
  required_providers {
    google = {
      source  = "hashicorp/google"
      version = "~> 4.15"
    }
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 3.20"
    }
    kubernetes = {
      source  = "hashicorp/kubernetes"
      version = "~> 2.11"
    }
  }
}
```

elaine: CI should be using a regenerated lockfile (`terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64`) — if you can't reproduce the exact lockfile, that's ok, I'll handle regen and upload.

devops-bot: CI update — terraform validate passed. plan job queued.

sam: plan succeeded locally after bypassing the mirror and setting provider overrides. Small drift: `kubernetes_manifest.app` changed `metadata.annotations` ordering only. No resource replacement.

tara: good. once the lockfile is uploaded I'll bump the K8s sidecar image to include the updated secret-path mapping and redeploy the deployment (no downtime expected).

mike: one more ask — can we add a small compatibility shim in `modules/core/outputs.tf` to map old annotation keys to the new one for one release? Prevents dual config churn.

elaine: yeah I'll add a noop output that keeps the old key in place for a week, then remove. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR and tag everyone.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled for 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC if all checks pass.

sam: thanks — I'll mark the PR as reviewed and re-run CI after elaine uploads the lockfile. :thumbsup:

elaine: thanks all — will upload lockfile in ~20m and notify here. If anyone sees any unexpected replacements in canary, ping me and I'll roll back.

devops-bot: PR #4928 — lockfile uploaded by elaine. plan job re-run -> plan shows only annotation reordering, no replacements.

mike: LGTM.

tara: LGTM from apps side.

sam: LGTM, merging after canary window. :shipit:

elaine: merging now, will watch canary and post updates.
